test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 26 Dec, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In which of the following months was the Project PARI (Public Art of India) initiated?
solution:
The correct answer is __**July 2024**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Project PARI (Public Art of India) was initiated on **Mon Jul 01 2024**.
 
• The project aims to promote **public art and cultural heritage** across India.
 
• It involves collaboration with various **local and international artists** to create public art installations.
 
• The initiative is supported by the Ministry of Culture and various **state governments**.
 
• The project also aims to **engage communities** in the creation and appreciation of public art.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Public Art**

 
 
• Public art refers to works of art that are designed to be displayed in public spaces.
 
• It includes sculptures, murals, installations, and other forms of art that are accessible to the public.
 
• Public art can enhance the aesthetic appeal of a community and promote cultural heritage.
 
 
 
• **Ministry of Culture**
 
 
• The Ministry of Culture is responsible for the preservation and promotion of art and culture in India.
 
• It supports various cultural projects and initiatives across the country.
 
 
 
• **Community Engagement**
 
 
• Community engagement involves the participation of local communities in the planning and execution of projects.
 
• It fosters a sense of ownership and pride among community members.
 
 
 
• **Cultural Heritage**
 
 
• Cultural heritage includes tangible and intangible assets that are inherited from past generations.
 
• It encompasses traditions, practices, places, objects, and artistic expressions.
